acceptanceCriteria: A finding whose helper chain crosses a changed span is in changed-line scope and names the changed helper file:line
A fixture test covers a helper-only change in the same file and in an imported module
UNKNOWN findings from the same unresolved helper are grouped (one finding listing call sites) or the spec records why not
body: Residual of V1-1769 (PR #1119, GitHub #1114), recorded in the TSA failure modes. Changed-line scoping uses the assertion/locator span at the call site. If a diff changes only the helper body (e.g. a page-object helper switches to `isVisible()` or adds `exact: true`), the calling `expect(await helper())` findings stay out of scope and are not reported for that change. Expected: a finding whose resolution path passes through a changed helper span is in scope, naming the changed helper location. Related: on split tests each call of an unresolved helper gives one UNKNOWN line, which can be noisy; consider grouping UNKNOWNs per helper.
title: tests lint: a change only inside a helper's definition does not bring calling one-shot/exact-text findings into changed-line scope (residual of V1-1769)
